description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_mysql' which implements database schema manipulation and metadata methods specific to MySQL for the ADOdb database abstraction library. It includes functions for mapping data types, generating SQL statements for indexes and table modifications, and handling column attributes.

classes.name: ADODB2_mysql
classes.description: A class that provides MySQL-specific implementations for database schema operations within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Maps a PHP data type to a database-specific type code used internally in the system.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts a type code to its actual database type name.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffixes for column definitions based on attributes like unsigned, nullability, default value, auto_increment, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating, replacing, or dropping indexes on a table.
